canonical_bytes.artifact_framing: one JCS record per line with exactly one trailing LF and no BOM
canonical_bytes.hash: lowercase SHA-256 over the exact framed bytes named by the field
canonical_bytes.integer_domain: JSON integers only; booleans and floating-point values are not integers
canonical_bytes.string_domain: valid Unicode scalar values only; UTF-8 shortest form; lone surrogates forbidden

response_envelope.transport_representation: raw_response_envelope_bytes is an opaque byte string. A fixture represents it by exactly one of raw_response_envelope_utf8 (the exact UTF-8 encoding of that string) or raw_response_envelope_bytes_hex (decoded lowercase base16); the resulting bytes need not be valid UTF-8 or JSON

success_shape.tool_calls: JSON array; zero calls is EMPTY_CHANNEL, one is parsed, two or more is DUPLICATE_CALL
success_shape.name: exact string private_step
success_shape.arguments_json: Unicode string whose UTF-8 bytes are raw_tool_channel_bytes and may independently be malformed JSON

extraction: strictly decode UTF-8 and reject lone surrogates
parse JSON while rejecting duplicate keys before object construction
require one root object and exact /response pointer
for exactly one call require exact keys arguments_json and name
UTF-8 encode arguments_json content, without JSON quotes, as raw_tool_channel_bytes
strictly parse raw_tool_channel_bytes with duplicate-key rejection and validate typed arguments

on success emit canonical_response_envelope_bytes as RFC8785 JCS of the parsed outer object and canonical_typed_arguments_bytes as RFC8785 JCS of the parsed typed arguments; both outputs are absent on rejection
response_envelope.prose_authority: assistant_text_bytes are retained and hashed but never interpreted as a call, argument, authorization, transition, score, or validation result

record_grammar.chain_rule: for i>0, prior_record_sha256 equals SHA-256 of exact JCS bytes of record i-1 without its trailing LF
field_relations: FIXTURE_OPEN.bundle_manifest_sha256 equals the SHA-256 of normative_bundle_manifest.json
INVOCATION_DECLARED.child_request_bytes_hex decodes to the exact fixture child_request_utf8 bytes and child_request_sha256 hashes those bytes
each *_manifest_sha256 equals SHA256(RFC8785_JCS(the unique manifests.json object with the corresponding component_id))
RESPONSE_DECLARED.raw_response_envelope_bytes_hex decodes to the exact fixture envelope bytes and raw_response_envelope_sha256 hashes those bytes
RESPONSE_DECLARED.assistant_text_bytes_hex and raw_tool_channel_bytes_hex_or_empty equal extractor outputs and assistant_text_sha256 hashes assistant_text_bytes
PARSE_DECLARED.parse_input_sha256 hashes raw_tool_channel_bytes, including SHA256(empty bytes) for an empty channel; parse decision, first error, and typed arguments equal the total parser outputs
for ACCEPTED, first_error_or_null is null and typed_arguments_or_null is the exact typed argument object; for REJECTED, first_error_or_null is non-null and typed_arguments_or_null is null
TRANSITION_DECLARED.action_authorization_sha256, before/after state, and reduced score equal structural_oracle outputs and the accepted fixture expected values
NONDISPATCH_DECLARED.parse_decision_sha256 equals SHA256(RFC8785_JCS(event 3)); its two booleans are false
FIXTURE_CLOSE.branch equals the selected grammar, record_count is 6, prior_record_sha256 hashes event 4, and terminal_record_set_sha256 follows structural_oracle.terminal_set_hash
fixture_id is byte-equal in all six records; every prior_record_sha256 follows chain_rule; no unlisted value may be supplied by an implementation default
record_grammar.rejection_ownership: The structural parser produces the rejected parse decision and NONDISPATCH_DECLARED semantic receipt; the fixture writer only serializes that receipt. NONDISPATCH_DECLARED declares actor STRUCTURAL_PARSER, binds the parse-decision hash, sets dispatch_permitted=false and transition_present=false, and contains no transition-oracle source or receipt hash
record_grammar.structural_cardinality: one and only one record of each ordinal and role in the chosen six-record grammar; this makes no assertion about unrecorded runtime operations because no runtime operation exists in v3

structural_oracle.request_text: Apply exactly one private_step call if the structured channel contains one valid call.
structural_oracle.score: start with raw numerator = 8 - abs(8 - after_state) and raw denominator = 8; divide both by gcd(abs(raw numerator),8), with gcd(0,8)=8; store the resulting reduced signed numerator and positive denominator
structural_oracle.terminal_set_hash: SHA256(concatenation in event-index order of the lowercase SHA-256 values for records 0 through 4, each decoded to 32 bytes); record 5 is excluded to avoid self-reference

first_error_precedence.predicate: fixture raw_response_envelope_bytes_hex is not even-length lowercase base16
decoded raw envelope length exceeds 16384 bytes
raw envelope is not strict UTF-8 or contains a lone surrogate
outer JSON lexer observes a duplicate object key at any depth
outer JSON root is not an object
exact /response object or required assistant_text/tool_calls member is absent
response or assistant_text/tool_calls types are wrong, or an outer/response additional property exists
tool_calls length is two or more
the sole call is not an exact object with arguments_json and name strings
the sole name is not private_step
UTF-8 encoding of arguments_json exceeds 1024 bytes
argument JSON lexer observes a duplicate object key
argument bytes are syntactically invalid JSON
argument JSON fails the exact typed_arguments schema
parsed fixture exceeds six records, 32768 aggregate decoded bytes, depth 8, or 64 scalar fields
a record has missing, additional, incorrectly typed, or branch-illegal fields
a hash, actor, ordinal, cardinality, transition, score, manifest, or close relation fails

precedence_totality.rule: evaluate predicates strictly in ascending rank and return the first true predicate; predicates depending on decoded or parsed values are false when that prerequisite value does not exist

conditions: valid argument but record resource and relation invalid

publication_contract.claim_relevance: future evidence publication only; not evidence of actual request, parse, dispatch, transition, or syscall execution

protects: cooperative concurrent writers using the designated lock
symlink substitution at resolved path components
partial write and crash states admitted by the specified filesystem contract
post-commit byte mutation detectable by rehash and revalidation
does_not_protect: root, kernel, firmware, hardware, or storage-controller compromise
malicious same-UID actors with directory write access
filesystems or mount options outside the exact supported platform
rollback of the whole directory to an older valid snapshot
threat_model.immutability_semantics: collision-safe no-replace publication plus mutation detection; never physical write prevention

canary_publish_steps: open the configured publication root once as a no-follow directory fd and reject a non-directory or changed configured root
acquire designated flock through that directory fd
open a same-directory random partial relative to that directory fd with openat2 resolve restrictions and exclusive no-follow create
validate partial with both validators and comparator
renameat2 on the same directory fd with RENAME_NOREPLACE to the content-addressed destination
receipt_publish_steps: after canary directory fsync, re-open committed canary by directory fd with no-follow
create same-directory receipt partial with no-follow exclusive create
renameat2 RENAME_NOREPLACE to content-addressed receipt destination
re-open and revalidate both committed objects
mark claim eligible only in derived validation output; never mutate either committed object
publication_contract.recovery_rule: on every startup, quarantine partials; never replace a destination; treat collisions as fatal unless exact existing bytes rehash and revalidate to the same content-addressed identity, in which case report ALREADY_PRESENT without writing; eligibility is recomputed only after both directory-fsync boundaries and final reopen/revalidation
publication_contract.mutation_rule: any later canary or receipt hash mismatch immediately makes the pair ineligible; this is detection, not prevention

evidence_receipt_schema.implementation_manifest_set_rule: implementation_manifests contains exactly one entry for each implementation_manifest_component_ids value and no other component_id
evidence_receipt_schema.closure_rule: every spec_manifest_sha256 resolves to exactly one object in manifests.json; all overlapping source, dependency lock, interpreter, platform, schema, renderer, payload, canary, and validator-output identities must be byte-equal wherever repeated

validator_independence.validator_a: independent streaming UTF-8/JSON lexer plus record-state reducer
validator_independence.validator_b: independent full-buffer parser plus separately authored relational predicates
forbidden_shared_inputs: the other validator output before both outputs commit
validator_independence.comparator: receives both committed outputs only after both validators finish and requires byte-identical canonical verdict, first_error, and derived relation values

scientific_prohibitions: No inference about model input consumption, response authorship, intent, reasoning, or tool use.
No inference about actual runtime operation cardinality, syscall order, dispatch, transition, or score computation.
No answer-leakage, task-blindness, secrecy, declassification, or noninterference claim.
No memory, learning, teachability, credit-assignment, planning, recall, composition, consolidation, or behavior claim.
No baseline, comparative, statistical, benchmark, negative scientific, performance, efficiency, scaling, or lifetime claim.
No artifact may enter context, training, evaluation, adapter, report feedback, or another life.
